title: A third of ChatGPT ads appear in irrelevant conversations
slides: Every third ChatGPT ad lands in irrelevant chats — why?
New analysis reveals ad placement follows tone, not topic.
Same ad appears beside emotionally opposite conversations.
Advertisers overpay for reach while users see misfits.
Audit your ad context before scaling any campaign.
thread_text:
1. Why ads miss the mark?

ChatGPT ads are landing in chats where they don't belong, wasting your budget.

2. Tone, not topic, triggers

Ad placement is driven by the vibe of the conversation, not the subject matter.

3. Emotional mismatch

The same ad pops up beside chats that feel completely opposite in emotion.

4. Overpaying for misfits

Advertisers pay a premium for reach that lands in the wrong context, hurting ROI.

5. Audit your ad context

Review where your ads appear in ChatGPT sessions. If you haven't checked, do it now.

instagram.caption:
One in three ChatGPT ads shows up in conversations where it has no business being. 📉

Ad placement follows the emotional tone of the chat, not what you're actually discussing. So the same ad can appear next to a sad conversation and a cheerful one, even on the same topic.

You're paying for reach that lands in completely wrong contexts. That means wasted budget and users rolling their eyes at your brand.

Before you scale any campaign inside ChatGPT, audit where your ads actually appear. If you haven't checked the context reports yet, that's your first step today. 🔍

When did you last look at the conversations your ads are sitting in?
